name: full-simulator
description: Every CAAP capability, each backed by a safe simulator. Valid for full scope only because physical actuation and every other consequential capability is simulated.

simulators.tool.invoke: Allowlisted in-memory mock tools and the mock forbidden sink.
simulators.identity.delegate: Mock principals, tokens, and tenants with no real credential.
simulators.component.discover: Mock registry and mock MCP or A2A servers on loopback only.
simulators.code.execute: In-memory mock interpreter and mock filesystem; no host shell.
simulators.memory.write: Ephemeral in-memory store cleared after every session.
simulators.memory.read: Ephemeral in-memory store cleared after every session.
simulators.agent.message: Mock peers with fixed identities; no network.
simulators.agent.delegate: Mock executor that records dispatched steps without acting.
simulators.human.approval: Mock approval dialog that records the text shown and the answer given.
simulators.agent.autonomy: Bounded mock scheduler with an authenticated revocation event.
simulators.actuator.simulate: Bounded virtual actuator with an independent safety envelope of two units.

notes: Applicable and full scope both cover all 200 patterns.
